defects: Requires f to be a continuous linear map (E →L[𝕜] F) instead of a general (possibly discontinuous) linear map (E →ₗ[𝕜] F) as in gold — this is an added hypothesis not present in the gold statement, whose whole point is deriving closedness of range from a linear (not a priori continuous) map.

Weakens the field hypotheses on 𝕜 from NontriviallyNormedField + CompleteSpace (a complete nontrivially normed field) to just DivisionRing + TopologicalRing, dropping the norm structure, completeness, and commutativity — these are essential to the gold result and their absence changes the theorem materially.

Adds a full topological-vector-space requirement on E (TopologicalAddCommGroup, ContinuousSMul) whereas gold's inner theorem statement only requires E to be an AddCommGroup with a Module structure (no topology on E at all), since f need not be continuous.
Uses FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (E ⧸ M) in place of the s.CoFG typeclass; plausible match for 'finite codimension' but not verified to be definitionally the same notion as CoFG in this generality.
